Limits and sources of this screen

METHOD-001 This is a desk screen on open data, not a site assessment. Four official exclusion criteria are not mapped (aerodrome protection zones, species protection sites, category I animals, feasibility of the emergency plan), and the non-public security criteria are absent. A remaining cell is not a suitable site.

METHOD-002 Cells are about 260 m across and tested at their centre. Features narrower than a cell, such as single-object zones, monument zones, small key habitats and the shore building-ban zone, are sampled rather than fully represented, and the 350 m dwelling distance is measured from the centre.

METHOD-003 The fault criterion buffers every mapped bedrock fault by 5 km. No Estonian fault is proven active, and the official plan judges faults site by site. This criterion alone removes several hundred square kilometres of coast.

DATA-001 The plan dropped its three Lüganuse sites in October 2026 on defence grounds that are not public. Public defence sites and their zones are mapped here; the non-public considerations are not.

DATA-002 The map service that publishes the official sites and planning area (gis.skpk.ee) states no licence. The geometries are public planning material of a state special plan.

DATA-003 Four monument-zone records were served with coordinates that are not L-EST97 metres and were left out at acquisition. They are listed in data/source/acquisition.json.

DATA-004 Population refers to 2024; all other layers are snapshots of 22 November 2026. The criteria follow the plan documents of 4 November 2026, which are a draft under public consultation.

Source providers: Keskkonnaagentuur (Estonian Environment Agency), EELIS nature register; Keskkonnaagentuur / Ministry of Climate; Maa- ja Ruumiamet (Land and Spatial Development Board); Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications; Skepast&Puhkim OÜ (plan consultant); Muinsuskaitseamet (National Heritage Board), published in the restrictions register; Päästeamet (Rescue Board) open data, published by Maa- ja Ruumiamet; Statistics Estonia, published by Maa- ja Ruumiamet (INSPIRE).
